shortDescription: A former banker at Deutsche Bank has withdrawn a lawsuit seeking €152 million ($176.62 million) in damages from the bank, according to a Frankfurt court on Monday.Deutsche Bank said the parties had resolved the case and didn't provide further details.($1 = 0.8606 euros)

children: A former banker at Deutsche Bank has withdrawn a lawsuit seeking €152 million ($176.62 million) in damages from the bank, according to a Frankfurt court on Monday.
Deutsche Bank said the parties had resolved the case and didn't provide further details.
